checks: New operational launcher only; frozen scientific auditor, producers, economic rules and policies remain unchanged.
Exact scientific CLI and request schema: FULL_H1, six ordered months, string audit paths and separate monthly_audit_sha256.
Draft is nested/non-authorizing, carries twelve null closure hashes and pending authority fields, and retains exact source request roots and audit binding.
External scientific review cf7a and all thirteen original binding files must be pinned; absence of decision field is respected.
Future supervisor has its own independent code/import review and external request/binding/publication hashes; no inferred or circular runtime authority.

Upstream admission requires actual pipeline completion plus retained exit0 and supervisory completion, exact process_files and pipeline_closure schemas, twelve starts/receipts and fixed monthly closure pairs.
Metadata admission excludes Request/MonthlyInputs/audit/Monthly/reconstruction helpers and avoids invoking validate_pipeline or rehashing scientific payload inventories in the parent.
Fresh bounded output/log paths protect scientific roots, pipeline controls, logs, authorities, code and locks; links/junctions/redirected ancestors rejected.
Only after real upstream closure, acquire nonblocking own operational lock then pipeline GLOBAL_LOCK; frozen auditor never acquires GLOBAL_LOCK, so this lock order does not deadlock the child.
Small self-contained process/resource/lock primitives retain documented reviewed provenance and avoid importing scientific producers via the monthly helper.
Immediate Windows RAM/free-commit 2000000000-byte gate, fixed hidden Popen, durable oneclaim, retained original handle, finally drain and no retry/resume.
Original pre-Popen preflight SHA remains bound through process/exit/completion; real exit must be preserved if later validation fails.
Final scientific audit status/scope/bindings/interpretation flags and required verified_files membership are checked without deciding economic gates; reject audit_failure.json, failures and partials.
Operational launch/snapshots belong to supervisor; design does not invent scientific launch.json or execution_snapshots fields.

Static workload formulas match audit_month loops: three historical selections per observable day/month and 1089 target selections, 2178 observable trajectories and36 missing coverage rows. These are counts from code, not measured time/memory/I/O.
Publication of design precedes fixtures; stable implementation review and real upstream closure precede final request/binding review/publication and root one-shot decision.
preconditions: Publish unchanged design/draft and this design review before executing new fixtures.
Independently review exact new launcher/tests bytes after synthetic fixtures; this design review does not certify future implementation.
No real auditor launch until producer and supervisor closure/retained exit0, exact reviewed request/runtime binding and verified publication exist.
limitations: No implementation fixtures, preflight, audit, MonthlyInputs, calibration, replay or benchmark executed for this design review.
No economic values, labels, scores, matrices, models or metrics opened.
Static workload counts are not runtime forecasts; resource gate is admission, not an RSS upper bound.
No filesystem-atomicity guarantee or survival guarantee against forced OS/process termination is inferred.
No process intervention or lock acquisition occurred during this review.
